items.source: Additional interface that can be implemented by Layouts that write their own loader classes.
items.translation: Layouts 可实现的附加接口，用于编写它们自己的加载器类。

items.source: Write the required loader classes into the JAR.
items.translation: 将所需的加载器类写入 JAR 中。

items.source: writer - the writer used to write the classes
IOException - if the classes cannot be written
items.translation: IOException - 如果无法写入这些类

items.source: This is a functional interface and can therefore be used as the assignment target for a lambda expression or method reference.
items.translation: 这是一个函数式接口，因此可用作 Lambda 表达式或方法引用的赋值目标。
